title: Python Foundations Through Explanation and Practice
summary: A beginner path from basic Python expressions through a small reviewed program, with explanation-back and revision evidence at each stage.
depth_rationale: The declared starting point supports a beginner path without assuming prior programming mastery.
objectives: Read and explain basic Python expressions and statements.
Use variables, conditionals, loops, and functions in small programs.
Test, revise, and explain a small program using observed behavior as evidence.

prerequisites.description: Open, save, and locate a text or code file.

units.title: Values, Expressions, and Variables
outcomes: Explain how a value becomes bound to a variable and predict simple expression results.
evidence_expectations: Participant correctly predicts and explains at least three simple expressions.
units.progression_gate: Proceed when the participant can explain variable assignment without relying on memorized wording.

units.title: Conditionals and Loops
outcomes: Use conditional logic and repetition to implement a small stated behavior.
activities: Revise a loop after observing incorrect behavior
evidence_expectations: Participant can explain why a branch or loop executes in a given example.
units.progression_gate: Proceed when the participant can change control flow to satisfy a new requirement and explain the change.

units.title: Functions, Testing, and Small Project
outcomes: Decompose a small requirement into functions and revise the result from test evidence.
evidence_expectations: Participant produces a small working program and a plain-language explanation of one revision.
units.progression_gate: Complete when the program, explanation, and revision evidence satisfy the curriculum completion criteria.

completion_criteria: All required unit progression gates are satisfied.
Participant produces a small Python program matching an agreed requirement.
Participant explains at least one defect and evidence-supported revision.
Required human review is completed before the curriculum is marked complete.
non_capture_note: Completion records evidence for this curriculum version only and does not define the participant's permanent capability or identity.
